summary_en: Nationals of 61 countries can enter Hainan Province without a visa for up to 30 days, through any of Hainan's open ports, for tourism, business, visits, family visits, medical treatment, exhibitions or sports. Work and study are excluded. The stay is limited to Hainan Province. Leaving Hainan for other parts of China needs a visa from the Hainan exit and entry authorities. The list grew to 61 countries on 20 August 2026. Indian passports are not on the eligible list.
summary_zh: 61国普通护照人员可免签入境海南，停留不超过30天，适用旅游、商贸、访问、探亲、就医、会展、体育竞技等事由。工作、学习除外。活动范围为海南省行政区域。离开海南前往中国其他地区须向海南公安出入境部门申办签证。2026年8月20日起适用国家增至61国。印度护照不在适用名单内。

summary_en: Nationals of 57 countries transiting China to a third country or region can enter without a visa and stay up to 240 hours (10 days). It requires an onward ticket with a confirmed seat and date to a third country or region, and entry through one of 65 designated ports across 24 provinces. Tourism, business, exchange and family visits are allowed. Work, study and journalism are not. This policy replaced the old 72 hour and 144 hour rules on 17 December 2024. Nationals of all other countries can transit visa-free for up to 24 hours at open ports.
summary_zh: 57国公民经中国前往第三国或地区，可免签入境并停留不超过240小时（10天）。须持前往第三国或地区的联程客票（座位和日期已确认），从24个省份的65个指定口岸入境。可从事旅游、商贸、交流、探亲活动。工作、学习、新闻采访除外。该政策于2024年12月17日取代原72小时和144小时过境免签。其他国家公民可在开放口岸享受24小时过境免签。

title_en: Korea visa-free entry for Chinese group tours and Jeju
title_zh: 韩国对中国团队游客免签及济州政策
summary_en: Chinese group tourists in groups of 3 or more recruited by designated travel agencies can enter Korea visa-free for up to 15 days. The scheme runs through 31 December 2026. Individual tourists are not covered and still need a visa. Jeju Island separately allows Chinese nationals visa-free entry for up to 30 days for both individual and group tourism.
summary_zh: 由专门旅行社招募的3人及以上中国团队游客可免签入境韩国，停留不超过15天。该政策实施至2026年12月31日。个人游客不适用，仍需办理签证。济州岛另行对中国公民实施30天免签，个人游和团队游均可。
